description: This file provides bit manipulation utilities, including bit masks, bit counting, bit reversal, and bit swapping functions, primarily for unsigned integer types. It includes templates and specializations for built-in types, and is part of the 'ocudu' namespace.

classes.name: bitset_builtin_helper
classes.description: Template struct providing bit counting functions such as leading zeros, trailing zeros, and population count for unsigned integers, with specializations for built-in types.

methods.name: mask_msb_zeros
methods.description: Returns an unsigned integer with the N most significant bits set to zero and the rest to one.

methods.name: mask_lsb_ones
methods.description: Returns an unsigned integer with the N least significant bits set to one.

methods.name: mask_msb_ones
methods.description: Returns an unsigned integer with the N most significant bits set to one.

methods.name: mask_lsb_zeros
methods.description: Returns an unsigned integer with the N least significant bits set to zero.

methods.name: bit_reverse
methods.description: Reverses the bits of a 64-bit unsigned integer.

methods.name: zero_msb_count
methods.description: Counts the number of leading zero bits starting from the most significant bit.

methods.name: find_first_msb_one
methods.description: Finds the position of the first set bit from the MSB side.

methods.name: find_first_lsb_one
methods.description: Finds the position of the first set bit from the LSB side.

methods.name: count_ones
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to one in an integer.
